description: Reusable opaque authored prop or hard-surface asset delivered to Gummy Bears as a self-contained glTF PBR asset.

notes: Crate is the initial technical benchmark.
The first production trial is an opaque authored asset selected separately.

requirements.axes: Blender +Z up; glTF conversion and destination orientation verified
requirements.uv: Active render UV required when a texture or normal map is used
requirements.geometry: Intended closed solids remain manifold; intentional open panels are declared
requirements.source: Editable Blender source preserved; destructive processing happens on an export copy

notes: Procedural Blender graphs must be converted or baked for glTF.
Do not bake lighting or reflections into base color.

textures.source: reusable albedo or baked source-to-export channels
textures.tiling: Verify tiling when a texture is intended to repeat

limits: Provisional profile; not yet validated on a production opaque asset.
No hard geometry or texture budget is established here.
Validator conformance does not prove destination appearance.
